svg.text: Desk Bike brake motor H-bridge — two IRF4905 / IRFZ44N half-bridges with 2N3904 gate drivers (5 V)
GND (single point at the ESP / bridge)
bulk + HF decoupling, at the bridge
GPIO high → Q3 on → node D ≈ 0 V
→ P-FET on, N-FET off → output 5 V
GPIO low → Q3 off → R1 pulls D to 5 V
→ P-FET off, N-FET on → output GND
R3 holds the input low while the ESP boots.
TO-220 (flat face, legs down): G · D · S, tab = D
2N3904 (flat face, legs down): E · B · C
